name: Hashrate re-arm with calm equity vol (VIX) — miner conviction while macro fear is contained
rationale: Crypto trends are vulnerable to macro risk-off shocks; an elevated VIX is the classic warning that cross-asset deleveraging can swamp crypto-internal signals. The thesis gates miner commitment on a benign equity-vol backdrop: btc_hashrate crosses UP (miners re-arm — on-chain structural conviction) WHILE vix_level is BELOW a fitted ceiling (macro fear is contained, no systemic stress) AND momentum is positive. The miner signal is the alpha source; the calm VIX is the external safety filter that keeps us out when a macro shock would override on-chain conviction. Go long spot. vix_level is BOUNDED and gated by lt on its raw ~12-80 level; btc_hashrate is drifting and read ONLY via cross_up/cross_down. Exit when VIX spikes past an exit ceiling (macro stress) or miners capitulate. Disconfirmer (core falsifier): the edge must come from miner re-commitment, not from the calm-VIX filter. If replacing the btc_hashrate cross_up arm with an always-true pass (keeping vix_level<ceiling + ret_Nd>0) matches or beats deflated Sharpe, hashrate is redundant and this is just a VIX-gated momentum trade. Low-confidence until OOS; the Gate decides.
catalyst: btc_hashrate crosses up while VIX is contained (below ceiling) and momentum is positive
